Catalinbread browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Catalinbread Giygas 2K - Fuzz Published on August 22, 2025 Catalinbread fuzz pedal Information The Catalinbread Giygas 2K is a streamlined two-knob fuzz pedal based on the original Giygas design. Marketed as "the Muff for people that don't like Muffs" , it features a modified fuzz engine that captures the character of classic Muff-style circuits without their drawbacks. The 2K version strips the control set down to the essentials, offering quick and intuitive operation while retaining the tonal flexibility of its predecessor. Unlike traditional Muff pedals that employ a dual-filter tone circuit, the Giygas 2K avoids the lossy mid-scooping design, delivering a punchy tonal profile that interacts naturally with the surrounding circuitry. The fuzz control provides a wide sweep, ranging from a warm, gritty boost at lower settings to thick, square-wave fuzz saturation at higher levels. It also cleans up dynamically with the guitar's volume knob, making it highly responsive to playing nuances. Controls Loud: Sets the overall output volume, from quiet to high-gain levels. Fuzz: Adjusts the amount of fuzz, ranging from subtle grit and boost to full, harmonically rich saturation. Specifications Power: Standard 9V DC, center-negative (current draw not specified, higher current acceptable) Construction: Compact enclosure with simplified 2-knob layout Circuit: Modified Muff-style fuzz without mid-scooping tone circuit Connections: Standard ¼" input and output jacks Highlights Two-knob evolution of the original Catalinbread Giygas fuzz Modified fuzz circuit offering Muff-style tones without the drawbacks Wide dynamic response with volume-knob cleanup Compact, intuitive design optimized for quick setup and use Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2025-08-22 JayLeonardJuatco The Catalinbread Giygas 2K Fuzz | No Talk - All Tones! 6:36 Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet  + Add your review Links Catalinbread Catalinbread Giygas 2K Fuzz (B-Stock) Catalinbread Giygas 2K - Fuzz Related Catalinbread Giygas - Versatile Fuzz/EQ Catalinbread Giygas 2K - Fuzz Where to find one?
